_comment: Is the rails release out? The rails pages describe commands (`champollion new`, `next`, `data`, the MCP server's rails profile, `nmt-forge floor`, `mt-eval translate/serve`) that the packages published on 2026-10-11 do NOT have, at the SAME version numbers as this tree. While `railsReleased` is false, every rails page says so (a 'Not released yet' notice), and each file in `preReleaseFiles` (llms.txt and for-agents.md are served even behind the pre-launch gate; the gate page's own copy is middleware.js) carries its `marker` — with the published versions where `versions` is true; scripts/check-site-claims.mjs fails if either is missing. At release, set `railsReleased` to true AND fill `railsVersions` with the versions that carry the rails: the build then pins them in the commands it shows (an agent prompt can never fetch an older server), refuses to build with a version missing, and the check fails until every marker is gone. `published` records what `npm view` / PyPI returned on `checked`.
